pages.title: The Trick
pages.text: Near the crack, an ender pearl would not fly straight. It leaned toward it.$(br2)Throw a pearl and for one blink you are $(thing)nowhere$(), then the world takes you back. The crack was that blink, held open. I wanted one I could carry out of the cave.

Amethyst holds a pearl still. Four shards around one and it stops wanting to go anywhere. It darkens, it cracks, and in the crack there are $(thing)stars$(), like the cave's. Then it splits in half: two $(item)void pearls$().
Obsidian set around a void pearl splits along lines that were not there before. The $(item)rift shards$() stay warm, and the light in them never settles. Eight from each attempt.
An eye of ender looks for a place. Bound in shards and crying obsidian, the $(item)rift eye$() looks for a place that does not exist yet. It took me the longest to find.
